claim.text: RoPE rotates each absolute position, and the attention score depends only on the relative distance between the tokens.

spec.explain: Illustrative toy from arXiv 2104.09864: the dial shows absolute position m rotated by f, while the score dial shows attention depending only on relative distance d.

questions.q: Predict the score when d = 3 and f = 0.5?
What is the angle when m = 8 and f = 0.5?
What is the score when d = 0 and f = 0.5?
What is the angle when m = 12 and f = 0.3?

widget.draw: function draw(ctx, state, t) { var w = state.w; var h = state.h; var m = state.m; var f = state.f; var d = state.d; function fmt(v) { return Math.round(v * 100) / 100; } var angle = m * f; var rel = d * f; var score = Math.cos(rel); var aFmt = fmt(angle); var sFmt = fmt(score); var cx1 = w * 0.27; var cx2 = w * 0.65; var cy = h * 0.48; var r = h * 0.28; var i = 0; var a = 0; var x1 = 0; var y1 = 0; var x2 = 0; var y2 = 0; ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.fillStyle = "#f6f3ec"; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.strokeStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx1, cy, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx2, cy, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke(); for (i = 0; i < 12; i++) { a = i * Math.PI / 6; x1 = cx1 + Math.cos(a) * r; y1 = cy + Math.sin(a) * r; x2 = cx1 + Math.cos(a) * (r - 9); y2 = cy + Math.sin(a) * (r - 9); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1, y1); ctx.lineTo(x2, y2); ctx.stroke(); x1 = cx2 + Math.cos(a) * r; y1 = cy + Math.sin(a) * r; x2 = cx2 + Math.cos(a) * (r - 9); y2 = cy + Math.sin(a) * (r - 9); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1, y1); ctx.lineTo(x2, y2); ctx.stroke(); } a = angle - Math.PI / 2; ctx.strokeStyle = "#b33a2b"; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx1, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx1 + Math.cos(a) * r, cy + Math.sin(a) * r); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx1, cy, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); a = rel - Math.PI / 2; ctx.strokeStyle = "#1f7a3a"; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx2, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx2 + Math.cos(a) * r, cy + Math.sin(a) * r); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx2, cy, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); var tx = cx2 + r + 22; ctx.strokeStyle = "#222222"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx, cy - r); ctx.lineTo(tx, cy + r); ctx.stroke(); var my = cy - sFmt * r; if (my < cy - r) { my = cy - r; } if (my > cy + r) { my = cy + r; } ctx.fillStyle = "#1f7a3a"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx, my, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = "#222222"; ctx.font = "14px sans-serif"; ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.fillText("absolute m dial", cx1, cy - r - 14); ctx.fillText("relative d dial", cx2, cy - r - 14); ctx.fillText("angle = m x f = " + aFmt, cx1, cy + r + 24); ctx.fillText("score = cos(d x f) = " + sFmt, cx2, cy + r + 24); }
